GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped awkwardly then hampered & Settled Down 3.5 Lengths on fence, Drifted Back to 4 Lengths turning, imoproved a length or So maintaining 5th place in the Straight # never a real threat
Jumped only fairly & Settled Down 4.5 Lengths on fence, little change to 5 Lengths rail turning, Held Up home turn then blocked in Straight # Had some excuses
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced in restricted room for a short distance near the 900m. Held up for clear running round home turn and in the early part of the home straight. Noted to have lost n/fore plate following the event.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 6 Lengths on fence, railed up to 2 Lengths turning, off heels Straightening Up and hit Lead 140m, kept going to post. # solid win

Jumped only fairly & Settled Down 3 Lengths Four Wide , in 3 Wide at 850m, held together much same to turn then shifted wider again, trailed 3 Lengths Four Wide turning, laid out home turn then Lost Ground in straight. [Stewards: Raced keenly early/middle stages.] # Wide throughout
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keenly in the early and middle stages. Raced wide without cover for a majority of the event. Laid out rounding the home turn.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay, not bustled early & Settled Down 7.5 Lengths Two Wide , Drifted Back to 10 Lengths 3 Wide turning, Made Some Ground in Straight # never a threat
Jumped Ok Not Bustled Settled Down 7th 4-5 Lengths into Clear Outside Soon After Straightening Up kept trying without threatening - # Closest on line
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When under pressure in the straight laid out.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay, Eased & Settled Down 4.5 Lengths Two Wide , made no ground to Turn then couldn't really come on in Straight # only plugged
Jumped only fairly & Settled Down 7 Lengths Four Wide , Made Some Ground to 6 Lengths Four Wide turning, lost a length in Straight # never on track
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Bumped on jumping. Raced wide throughout.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 1.5 Lengths 3 Wide , Moved Up Two Wide Outside Lead at 850m, held together much same to turn 1 length Two Wide , kept coming in Straight and hit Lead 20m from post # battled on well

Jumped okay & Settled Down 5 Lengths on fence, Drifted Back (4-then-3 Lengths leader middle stages) to 6 Lengths turning, shifted out Straightening Up and Made Some Ground in Straight # never a factor
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When the pace eased near the 900m, improved onto heels and was steadied. Improved onto heels near the 600m and was steadied. Approaching the 200m was steadied. Laid out from the 150m when placed under pressure.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 1.25 Lengths 3 Wide , in Two Wide at 900m, held together much same to turn 2 Lengths Two Wide , moved up and joined Lead 250m, took narrow Lead at 200m, went clear final 100m. [Stewards: Rider advised she didn't intend racing in a forward position but after beginning well she rode it forward to obtain a position closer to the rail and settled outside the leader.] # solid win
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rdr reported not intention to race in a forward position, after beginning well from outside barrier, then rode mount forward in an endeavour to attain a position closer to rail and subsequently settled outside of leader.
